title: Holospiniferoside: A New Antitumor Cerebroside from The Red Sea Cucumber Holothuria spinifera: In Vitro and In Silico Studies.
authors: Eltamany, Enas E; Abdelmohsen, Usama Ramadan; Hal, Dina M; Ibrahim, Amany K; Hassanean, Hashim A; Abdelhameed, Reda F A; Temraz, Tarek A; Hajjar, Dina; Makki, Arwa A; Hendawy, Omnia Magdy; AboulMagd, Asmaa M; Youssif, Khayrya A; Bringmann, Gerhard; Ahmed, Safwat A
one_liner_zh: 该文从海参中分离新脑苷脂并做抗肿瘤活性与Mdm2-p53蛋白对接，属小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Chemical investigation of the methanolic extract of the Red Sea cucumber Holothuria spinifera led to the isolation of a new cerebroside, holospiniferoside (1), together with thymidine (2), methyl-alpha-d-glucopyranoside (3), a new triacylglycerol (4), and cholesterol (5). Their chemical structures were established by NMR and mass spectrometric analysis, including gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS). All the isolated compounds are reported in this species for the first time. Moreover, compound 1 exhibited promising in vitro antiproliferative effect on the human breast cancer cell line (MCF-7) with IC(50) of 20.6 microM compared to the IC(50) of 15.3 microM for the drug cisplatin. To predict the possible mechanism underlying the cytotoxicity of compound 1, a docking study was performed to elucidate its binding interactions with the active site of the protein Mdm2-p53. Compound 1 displayed an apoptotic activity via strong interaction with the active site of the target protein. This study highlights the importance of marine natural products in the design of new anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 对红海参（Holothuria spinifera）甲醇提取物的化学研究分离得到一种新的脑苷脂，holospiniferoside (1)，以及胸苷 (2)、甲基-α-d-吡喃葡萄糖苷 (3)、一种新的三酰甘油 (4) 和胆固醇 (5)。其化学结构通过核磁共振（NMR）和质谱分析确定，包括气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）和高分辨质谱（HRMS）。所有分离的化合物均为该物种中首次报道。此外，化合物1对人乳腺癌细胞系（MCF-7）表现出有前景的体外抗增殖作用，其IC(50)为20.6微摩尔，而药物顺铂的IC(50)为15.3微摩尔。为预测化合物1细胞毒性的可能机制，进行了分子对接研究，以阐明其与蛋白Mdm2-p53活性位点的结合相互作用。化合物1通过与靶蛋白活性位点的强相互作用表现出凋亡活性。本研究强调了海洋天然产物在设计新型抗癌药物中的重要性。
